text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein visits orphans to check on their conditions and is briefed on steps taken to move them to Hashemiyah palace.
- King starts European tour on Sunday and meets U.S. President Bill Clinton on March 18.
- Meeting of engineers union on Tuesday to take a decision on adopting new protest steps.
- Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Khaled al-Madadha resigns, officially submits letter to prime minister.
- Islamists debating whether to leave it to grassroots to decide on boycotting parliamentary sessions.
- Jordan says it has notified Iraq of its desire to have access to the investigation files on the killing of its embassy driver.
- An extensive Israeli settlement drive in Jordan Valley.
- Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti holds talks with the ambassadors of Tunisia, Qatar and Italy.
